name: Mize
description: Logs every job application and shows which employers actually reply.
notes: Search names the limits an advert sets: 18+ and a driving licence show on the row, and jobs that rule you out stay hidden until you ask for them under Also show in the filters.
Pay not listed now says the least the law lets the job pay at your age.
An application worth a follow-up tells you what to do: walk in or ring them and ask if the job is still open.
